epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase backend container successful startup rate from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: The backend container must initialize its web server and respond successfully to health check connections without RemoteDisconnected errors.

slices.title: Fix backend container startup connection drops
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to identify and resolve the RemoteDisconnected error during startup, so that the backend service correctly exposes its ports and passes the health check.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the local or CI environment is starting
When the backend container is launched
Then Tomcat must bind correctly and the health check endpoint must return a successful response without connection drops.
